motions.item_title: 65 McTague Street – Notice of Intention to Designate, 2026-231
motions.text: That the City Clerk be authorized to publish and serve notice of intention to designate 65 McTague Street pursuant to Part IV, Section 29 of the Ontario Heritage Act. That the designation bylaw be brought before Council for approval if no objections are received within the thirty (30) day objection period.
motions.text_html:
1. That the City Clerk be authorized to publish and serve notice of intention to designate 65 McTague Street pursuant to Part IV, Section 29 of the Ontario Heritage Act.
  2. That the designation bylaw be brought before Council for approval if no objections are received within the thirty (30) day objection period.

motions.item_title: Decision Report, 70 Fountain Street East, Proposed Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendments, 2026-310
motions.name: Main Motion
motions.text: That the applications from UP Consulting, on behalf of Fitzrovia Residential Inc. for an Official Plan Amendment to retain the existing ‘Mixed Use-1’ designation while deleting Subsection 11.1.7.3.9.1 in its entirety, and a Zoning By-law Amendment to rezone the subject lands from D.1-27(H28) to a new site-specific D.1-29 zone together with lifting the holding symbol (H28) to permit a twenty-four storey, mixed-use building containing 440 square metres of ground floor retail, five stacked townhouse units, and 415 rental dwelling units on the lands municipally known as 70 Fountain Street East, and legally described as Lots 19 & 20, Registered Plan 8, City of Guelph from Infrastructure, Development and Environment dated March 10, 2026 be approved in accordance with Attachment-3 Recommended OPA, ZBA and Conditions of Approval . That in accordance with Section 34(17) of the Planning Act, City Council has determined that no further public notice is required related to the proposed Official Plan Amendment and Zoning By-law Amendment affecting lands municipally known as 70 Fountain Street East.
motions.text_html:
1. motions.item_title: Potential Opportunity to Advance Affordable Housing and Charitable Hub
motions.text: That in order to facilitate a transparent evaluation of a potential opportunity to advance a Community Hub and Affordable Housing on 14.8 acres of land outside of the City boundary in Guelph/Eramosa Township, that City Council requests a written draft proposal from the proponent be shared publicly with Council and staff for both the City of Guelph and Guelph/Eramosa Township. That upon receipt and public disclosure of the written draft proposal, City of Guelph staff be directed to engage in exploratory conversations with the proponent and Guelph/Eramosa staff, to assess the opportunities within the context of the development being cost neutral to the City, and report back on options and next steps for Council consideration.
motions.text_html:
1. That in order to facilitate a transparent evaluation of a potential opportunity to advance a Community Hub and Affordable Housing on 14.8 acres of land outside of the City boundary in Guelph/Eramosa Township, that City Council requests a written draft proposal from the proponent be shared publicly with Council and staff for both the City of Guelph and Guelph/Eramosa Township.
  2. That upon receipt and public disclosure of the written draft proposal, City of Guelph staff be directed to engage in exploratory conversations with the proponent and Guelph/Eramosa staff, to assess the opportunities within the context of the development being cost neutral to the City, and report back on options and next steps for Council consideration.

motions.name: Second Motion
motions.text: That the application regarding the proposed City-initiated Official Plan Amendment and Zoning By-law Amendment to redesignate and rezone the parcel of land with the legal description of PT LT 13 CON 5 Puslinch PT 1, 61R1483, be withdrawn, and that the file be closed. That Council acknowledges the expressions of community interest for these lands, with efforts to be developed into parkland, and directs staff ALONGSIDE THE MAYOR to send a letter to the Minister of Municipal Affairs and Housing to convey the public delegations AND THE HISTORICAL FINANCIAL CONTRIBUTIONS made by the City to the Province for their consideration, AND that Council invite the Province to meet with community advocates to explore a provincial rezoning decision for these lands.
